facts.fact: Data Protection Africa's factsheet says Equatorial Guinea has a comprehensive data protection law in place, Law No. 1/2016 on the Protection of Personal Data; no date of the statement is given, so the published date is used.
facts.system: Law No. 1/2016 on the Protection of Personal Data

facts.fact: Data Protection Africa's factsheet says Law 1/2016 creates the Governing Body for the Protection of Personal Data but the data protection authority is not yet appointed (document published 2022-05-23).
facts.system: Law No. 1/2016 on the Protection of Personal Data
